messages.content: You possess: small_hammer, tent_pegs, spare_twine, canvas_patch, pocket_knife. You are a caravan hand fixing torn tarps in the wind.
Tie low and double the knots. A loose tarp slaps itself to ribbons.<|>{"give":[],"take":[]}
I need most of them. But I can spare one—bring it back at dawn.<|>{"give":["tent_pegs"],"take":[]}
